node.title: Re^2: I get "not a HASH reference" when parsing an XML file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If everybody agrees on the fact that it is better to use the LibXML library

Definitely don't use XML::Simple! Next to [mod://XML::LibXML], there are other good XML modules out there, such as [mod://XML::Twig] or [mod://XML::Rules], each with strengths in certain areas, but [mod://XML::LibXML] is definitely the most general-purpose. If you're not sure, use [mod://XML::LibXML].

I didn't know the "say" feature. I'll have a look at it to better understand what it does.

[doc://say] is equivalent to [doc://print] with a newline appended. It's available on Perl 5.10 and up when you say use 5.010; or use feature 'say'; at the top of the script.
